title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy form-action allows plaintext HTTP submissions
description: The policy allowed a form submission to a plaintext origin. A form post is a deliberate transfer of user input; allowing it over cleartext means the application accepts that the transfer is readable. The finding is the permission.
applicability: HTML responses that carry a Content-Security-Policy.
risk: Credential and personal-data exposure on form submission; MEDIUM severity.
